"Let It Be" released as single first. Rocky Raccoon first on White Album. Which is correct? Text names album "Let It Be"; song first released on it — none directly... Let It Be song was on the album but single first. Probably answer: Let It Be, since album named. But "first released" excludes it. Ambiguous; choose "Let It Be"?
